title: Daily Intelligence Brief - May 24, 2026
summary: Five investigative threads moved in the 24-hour window. Indigenous Services Minister Mandy Gull-Masty's conflict-of-interest disclosure is 7 months past the statutory deadline -- direct cabinet-level CoIA breach. The special joint MAID committee is being publicly called biased by Canada's leading assisted-dying expert; co-chairs are both opposed to the 2027 mental-illness extension and 13 medical-school psychiatry chairs wrote requesting the federal government halt the expansion. Defence Minister McGuinty introduced a National Defence Act amendment to remove military jurisdiction over sexual offence investigations; Ontario MOU signed. Senator Yuen Pau Woo led 32 senators (one-third of the Senate) in calling for an arms-to-Israel investigation; Israel Tax Authority customs records detail 3 Montreal-Dorval -> Tel Aviv-Yafo cartridge shipments in Sept 2024, May 2025, July 2025. Bill C-9 awaits Senate review after House 188-144 passage. Quantum pipeline ran in dry-run mode (real local_gpu mode requires NATS broker + Ising bridge service).
